snippet.title: Pit Purge - Trailer
snippet.description:
An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. In the pit, the creatures are the loot. Hunt them or capture them alive, then send them up to get paid.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4950410/?utm_source=youtube

If you enjoy games like Lethal Company, R.E.P.O., Content Warning or Mimesis, this one's for you!

- 1–4 players, online co-op with proximity voice chat
- 6 sectors, 13 creatures : Hunt them down or capture them alive, and sell them.
- 20+ items: weapons, consumables, gadgets

After two and a half years of development, I’m finally ready to share my game with you, and I’m really proud to finally let you discover it. 

I hope you’ll have a great time playing it, just as much as I enjoyed developing it!
